description: How TmDateRangePicker derives the period its reported range is compared against: no comparison, the equally long period immediately before the selected one, the same period one year earlier (29 February clamped to 28 February), or a range the user picks.

members.name: PreviousPeriod
members.description: The equally long period immediately before the selected range.

members.name: PreviousYear
members.description: The same calendar range one year earlier, with 29 February clamped to 28 February.

members.name: Custom
members.description: The user picks the comparison range themselves.
